column3: MT 9:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1; “alumoth labben” is rendered “on Muth-labben.”
Close to the Hebrew; “You have done my justice and my cause” is rendered “You have maintained my just cause.”
The Hebrew is abrupt and ends with “they”; NASB renders it “The very memory of them has perished.” The meaning is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “He will judge the nations” is rendered “He will execute judgment for the peoples.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a refuge” is rendered “a stronghold.”
Close to the Hebrew; “He who seeks blood” is rendered “He who requires blood.”
“Striking down the wicked” is rendered “the wicked is snared,” and NASB takes “his own hands” as the wicked man's.
Close to the Hebrew; “set terror for them” is rendered “Put them in fear.”
